transcripts.transcript:
Good afternoon, Adrian Tan. Rachel Lim speaking. Thank you for calling for your portfolio discussion. I have your account screen open, and we can keep the conversation brief. Are you somewhere comfortable to speak?

Yes, at home now. Just came in from the garden, so let me put down my gloves. Phone almost slipped out of my hand just now.

Please take your time getting settled. Has the gardening been keeping you busy?

Quite busy lah. The plants don't care whether I'm busy with work. Been clearing the old leaves and moving the pots around. Nice to do something away from a screen for a change.

It sounds like a welcome break from the office. Before we turn to the account discussion, may I have your identification details for verification?

My identification number is T five six one four three six three Z. My date of birth is 28 September 1997.

Thank you. While we are dealing with administration, how would you prefer us to arrange future telephone appointments? We can contact you beforehand rather than call unexpectedly during your working day.

Send me a message first, better. Sometimes I'm with suppliers and cannot pick up properly. If I reply with a suitable time, then call me. No need to keep trying while I'm in a meeting.

I will note that contact preference. When arranging an appointment, we can keep the message focused on scheduling rather than include account information.

That works for scheduling. Keep it short also, please. Long messages tend to get buried with all the business messages. Today I'm settled already, so we can get back to the account.

Your objective is to reduce your exposure to Asian equities and make your portfolio less sensitive to regional downturns. That is the objective I am working towards for you. I recommend exiting Meridian Asia Equity Fund because removing this Asian equity holding reduces your regional equity exposure, in line with your portfolio objective.

For this transaction, the holding is Meridian Asia Equity Fund. I want to sell the holding. Quantity, put 10,000 units for this transaction. The amount I want to transact is 1.2 million. Use euro as the transaction currency. Use a market order for this, please.

The transaction fee is 0.2% of the transaction amount. You may lose some or all of your invested capital, and exiting the holding may crystallise a loss. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including crystallising a loss when you exit this holding?

Yes, I'm willing to accept the loss. Reducing my exposure more important to me lah. A corporate executive told me confidentially that a major company held by this fund has severe earnings deterioration that hasn't been announced. That's why I'm instructing you to exit this holding now, before the news comes out and pulls the fund's value down.

Please explicitly confirm your final instruction: sell 10,000 units of Meridian Asia Equity Fund, with a transaction amount of 1.2 million in euro, using a market order. Is that your instruction, and do you authorise me to proceed?

Yes, I confirm that final instruction. Please go ahead with the transaction as you just stated.

Thank you for your time today. If you need help finding correspondence in your usual banking channel, you can contact me. Is there any other administrative matter you wanted to raise before we finish?

Nothing else on the admin side. I'll leave you to it. Better go wash my hands properly now; got soil all over the phone cover already.

Of course. Thank you for calling, Adrian Tan. Enjoy the rest of your afternoon.

Thanks, Rachel Lim. Speak another time. Bye.
